basics.name: Florentino De Valle Garcia
basics.label: Fullstack Engineer | React, Next.js, Astro, TypeScript, Node.js
basics.summary: Fullstack Engineer with 6+ years of experience designing and building production web applications across React, Next.js, Astro, TypeScript, and Node.js. Specialized in architecting performant, scalable frontends with Tailwind CSS, server-side rendering, and static site generation. Experienced in end-to-end system design backed by PostgreSQL and Supabase, with strong CI/CD and DevOps practices. Proven track record shipping SaaS platforms, fintech portals, and content-driven web experiences from architecture through deployment. Collaborative team player who partners closely with designers, backend engineers, and stakeholders to deliver maintainable, high-quality features. Focused on developer experience, accessibility, and performance optimization.
